remarks: An incredible and rarely available opportunity to bring the floor plans from one of Brownstone Homes’ most remarkable custom builds to the 10th and final lot in this exclusive cul-de-sac at 11 Sanctuary Court in Amherst. Located within the sought-after Williamsville School District, this proposed modern luxury estate offers approximately 8,800 sq ft of finished living space with a rare 6 bedroom, 6 full bath, 2 half bath layout across three expansive levels. The main floor is anchored by a breathtaking two-story great room with soaring 20' ceilings and a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, opening to a covered outdoor living area. The proposed design includes fully retractable pocket-style doors in both the kitchen and living room, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. High-end details may include tray ceilings, 9/16" champagne white oak flooring, reverse brick ledge construction for flush first-floor transitions, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops and backsplashes, a Wolf six-burner cooktop, walk-in pantry, designer tile work, and top-tier finishes throughout. The first-floor primary suite is designed with a massive walk-in closet, fireplace, and a luxurious bath with dual vanities, dual showerheads, and a soaking tub within the shower. A second first-floor bedroom suite, private office, and impressive first-floor theater room with stadium-style seating complete the main level, while three additional bedroom suites are planned upstairs. The finished lower level is designed for elevated entertaining and recreation, including a lowered area ideal for a golf simulator and a walk-in safe. Additional proposed highlights include an oversized five-car garage, multiple gas fireplaces, built-in speakers, dedicated laundry rooms on both levels, and exceptional Brownstone Homes craftsmanship throughout. Every detail and finish can be customized with Brownstone Homes’ design team, allowing the buyer to personalize the home while maintaining the scale, presence, and vision of this remarkable floor plan. Final plans, finishes, pricing, and specifications are subject to builder approval and may vary.
